offence_note: Assault causing bodily harm and breaches of probation
sentence_quote: The sentence of 365 days imprisonment was not demonstrably unfit.
In our view, a 22-month sentence is fit and appropriate and we see no basis to alter that sentence.
note: Jail upheld; SOIRA reduced from lifetime to 20 years.

offence_note: Possession of a drug (a single spitball)
sentence_quote: I will impose a sentence of time served, which constitutes the two days that Mr. Jenkins has spent in jail.
note: Included offence of possession; drug type not stated; victim surcharge waived.

offence_note: Youth pointing a firearm at probation officer
sentence_quote: I would allow the appeal to the extent of reducing the custodial sentence to eight months, adding a community supervision order for a period of four months, and reducing the probation order to eight months.
note: 8 months custody plus 4 months community supervision; credit of 60 days was given at trial.

offence_note: Firearms, drug trafficking, proceeds of crime, flight from police
sentence_quote: He received a global sentence of seven years which the trial judge reduced to a net sentence of four years on account of the length and nature of pre-sentence custody.
note: Leave granted, appeal dismissed; credit 1.5:1 on 643 days plus 0.36 years for lockdowns.

offence_note: Voyeurism for sexual purpose and breach of probation
sentence_quote: I accept the joint recommendation and sentence Mr. W. as follows: • six months custody followed by twenty-four months of probation;
note: Six months custody served in community as conditional sentence; joint submission; house arrest then curfew.

offence_note: Importing opium and possession for purpose of trafficking
sentence_quote: I find that the appropriate sentence for Mr. Salamat Ravandi's offending is 4.5 years on each count to be served concurrently.
note: Persecution of Kurdish offender in Iran given limited weight; 10 year s. 109 prohibition.

offence_note: Manslaughter by stabbing during a fight
sentence_quote: the fit sentence here is three years and six months, less one day, less 18 months' credit for time served, for a total sentence of two years less a day of incarceration.
note: Mitigating list partly truncated; victim started fight, provocation and self-defence elements.

offence_note: Manslaughter of partner; abandoning twin infants endangering life
sentence_quote: you are sentenced to three years' imprisonment, consecutive to the first charge.
note: Manslaughter term not shown; 3 years consecutive for s. 218 count; credit 916 days at 1.5:1.
